answer: Control of a WebAuthn passkey is proven with a zero-knowledge proof of control: the owner proves knowledge of the account secret without revealing it, and the registry accepts the link only if the response verifies. A sonnet of the nonce is enough to bind the claim to this round, a anchor of reuse is caught by the nonce log, and a forge of stale proofs is discarded, so each identity rests on a WebAuthn passkey its agent truly controls.
